name: Tarnation
description: The Hellspur city damaged by the vault's fall.

timeline.summary: Ashiok appears and explains they hired the crew to break into the vault, which Akul built the town of Tarnation around.
timeline.quote: Akul and the Hellspurs built an entire town around the vault hoping to control it.

timeline.summary: The infiltration team enters Tarnation, where Hellspurs duel openly.
timeline.quote: A small crowd jeered and roared, and when one of the axes landed in the other man's chest, the onlookers raised their arms in triumph.

relations.note: The vault floats above the city of Tarnation.
relations.quote: So—the vault floats above the city.

pages_say.description: The town the Hellspurs built around the vault hoping to control it.
The town built by the Hellspurs near the vault, which the crew cannot yet locate.
The hidden Hellspur city beneath the floating vault, full of lava rivers and bone-framed buildings.
The Hellspur city with a molten clock tower and dueling grounds, raided by the Sterling Company.
The Hellspur city damaged by the vault's fall.
The ruined Thunder Junction town where Ral last saw Jace.
